the maturation of the P-cluster, a complex metallocluster in the MoFe protein that mediates electron transfer to the active site FeMo-cofactor in the nitrogenase enzyme.

NifZ may not be a specific P-cluster maturation factor, as previously thought, and that the P-cluster maturation process may have a broader function than previously recognized.
